key_insight: MEDIATOR maps clinical text into shared discrete tokens, improving EHR prediction across hospitals without manual ontology mappings or a fixed vocabulary.
clinical_relevance: The approach could help prediction models reuse differently coded EHR data across health systems, but clinical utility remains unestablished.
method: Maps text-described clinical concepts into a shared vector-quantized codebook.
Learns from synonyms, enriched descriptions, code co-occurrence, and relation graphs.
Supplies ontology-agnostic tokens to an EHR Transformer.
evidence_signal: Across 20 MIMIC-III tasks and zero-shot transfer to 14 eICU tasks, MEDIATOR improved mean AUPRC over the strongest prior tokenizer by 4.0 and 8.6 points, respectively, while using all eICU events.
watch_item: Transfer gains reflect both broader event coverage and better representations; prospective clinical validation is not reported in the abstract.
paper_title: Discrete Neural Interlingua for Ontology-Agnostic EHR Modeling
